ck_access_challenges_target.name: ck_access_challenges_target
ck_access_challenges_target.value:
(
        "access_challenges"."purpose" = 'customer_sign_in' AND "access_challenges"."order_id" IS NULL
        AND ("access_challenges"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "access_challenges"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      ) OR (
        "access_challenges"."purpose" = 'guest_order_access' AND "access_challenges"."customer_id" IS NULL
        AND ("access_challenges"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "access_challenges"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

ck_access_challenges_token_hash.name: ck_access_challenges_token_hash
ck_access_challenges_token_hash.value:
length("access_challenges"."token_hash") = 64
        AND "access_challenges"."token_hash" = lower("access_challenges"."token_hash")
        AND "access_challenges"."token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

ck_access_challenges_timestamps.name: ck_access_challenges_timestamps
ck_access_challenges_timestamps.value:
strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "access_challenges"."created_at") = "access_challenges"."created_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "access_challenges"."expires_at") = "access_challenges"."expires_at"
        AND "access_challenges"."expires_at" > "access_challenges"."created_at"
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "access_challenges"."expires_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "access_challenges"."created_at") AS integer) <= 3600
        AND ("access_challenges"."dispatched_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "access_challenges"."dispatched_at") = "access_challenges"."dispatched_at")
        AND ("access_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "access_challenges"."consumed_at") = "access_challenges"."consumed_at")
        AND ("access_challenges"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "access_challenges"."revoked_at") = "access_challenges"."revoked_at")

ck_admin_sessions_token_hash.name: ck_admin_sessions_token_hash
ck_admin_sessions_token_hash.value:
length("admin_sessions"."token_hash") = 64
        AND "admin_sessions"."token_hash" = lower("admin_sessions"."token_hash")
        AND "admin_sessions"."token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("admin_sessions"."csrf_token_hash") = 64
        AND "admin_sessions"."csrf_token_hash" = lower("admin_sessions"."csrf_token_hash")
        AND "admin_sessions"."csrf_token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("admin_sessions"."evidence_hash") = 64
        AND "admin_sessions"."evidence_hash" = lower("admin_sessions"."evidence_hash")
        AND "admin_sessions"."evidence_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

ck_admin_sessions_timestamps.name: ck_admin_sessions_timestamps
ck_admin_sessions_timestamps.value:
strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."external_authenticated_at") = "admin_sessions"."external_authenticated_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."created_at") = "admin_sessions"."created_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."expires_at") = "admin_sessions"."expires_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."idle_expires_at") = "admin_sessions"."idle_expires_at"
        AND "admin_sessions"."external_authenticated_at" <= "admin_sessions"."created_at"
        AND "admin_sessions"."expires_at" > "admin_sessions"."created_at"
        AND "admin_sessions"."idle_expires_at" > "admin_sessions"."created_at"
        AND "admin_sessions"."idle_expires_at" <= "admin_sessions"."expires_at"
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."created_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."external_authenticated_at") AS integer) <= 300
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."expires_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."created_at") AS integer) <= 28800
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."idle_expires_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "admin_sessions"."created_at") AS integer) <= 900
        AND ("admin_sessions"."last_seen_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."last_seen_at") = "admin_sessions"."last_seen_at")
        AND ("admin_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "admin_sessions"."revoked_at") = "admin_sessions"."revoked_at")

ck_carrier_receipts_fingerprints.name: ck_carrier_receipts_fingerprints
ck_carrier_receipts_fingerprints.value:
length("carrier_event_receipts"."event_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "carrier_event_receipts"."event_fingerprint" = lower("carrier_event_receipts"."event_fingerprint")
        AND "carrier_event_receipts"."event_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("carrier_event_receipts"."receipt_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "carrier_event_receipts"."receipt_fingerprint" = lower("carrier_event_receipts"."receipt_fingerprint")
        AND "carrier_event_receipts"."receipt_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

ck_carrier_receipts_state.name: ck_carrier_receipts_state
ck_carrier_receipts_state.value:
("carrier_event_receipts"."status" = 'verified' AND "carrier_event_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("carrier_event_receipts"."status" = 'consumed' AND "carrier_event_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_customer_sessions_source_shape.name: ck_customer_sessions_source_shape
ck_customer_sessions_source_shape.value:
(
        "customer_sessions"."authentication_source" = 'challenge'
        AND "customer_sessions"."issued_by_challenge_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "customer_sessions"."rotated_from_session_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "customer_sessions"."authentication_source" = 'rotation'
        AND "customer_sessions"."issued_by_challenge_id" IS NULL
        AND "customer_sessions"."rotated_from_session_id" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "customer_sessions"."authentication_source" = 'legacy_revoked'
        AND "customer_sessions"."issued_by_challenge_id" IS NULL
        AND "customer_sessions"."rotated_from_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "customer_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

idx_customers_account_enabled.name: idx_customers_account_enabled
idx_customers_account_enabled.where: "customers"."account_enabled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ck_customs_records_fingerprint.name: ck_customs_records_fingerprint
ck_customs_records_fingerprint.value:
"customs_records"."record_fingerprint" IS NULL
        OR (length("customs_records"."record_fingerprint") = 64
          AND "customs_records"."record_fingerprint" = lower("customs_records"."record_fingerprint")
          AND "customs_records"."record_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

ck_customs_records_ready_shape.name: ck_customs_records_ready_shape
ck_customs_records_ready_shape.value:
("customs_records"."status" = 'ready' AND "customs_records"."manual_reference" IS NOT NULL
          AND "customs_records"."record_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "customs_records"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("customs_records"."status" <> 'ready' AND "customs_records"."ready_at" IS NULL)

ck_data_retention_activation.name: ck_data_retention_activation
ck_data_retention_activation.value:
"data_retention_rules"."active" = 0 OR (
        "data_retention_rules"."retention_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "data_retention_rules"."effective_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "data_retention_rules"."created_by_admin_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

ck_data_rights_actor.name: ck_data_rights_actor
ck_data_rights_actor.value:
("data_rights_requests"."actor_type" = 'customer' AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_order_id" IS NULL AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."target_customer_id" = "data_rights_requests"."actor_customer_id"
          AND "data_rights_requests"."target_order_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("data_rights_requests"."actor_type" = 'guest' AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."target_customer_id" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."target_order_id" = "data_rights_requests"."actor_order_id")
        OR ("data_rights_requests"."actor_type" = 'admin' AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_order_id" IS NULL AND "data_rights_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND (("data_rights_requests"."target_customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "data_rights_requests"."target_order_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("data_rights_requests"."target_customer_id" IS NULL AND "data_rights_requests"."target_order_id" IS NOT NULL)))

ck_data_rights_retention.name: ck_data_rights_retention
ck_data_rights_retention.value:
("data_rights_requests"."retention_decision" = 'unevaluated'
          AND "data_rights_requests"."retention_policy_version" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."retention_required_until" IS NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."active_dispute" IS NULL)
        OR ("data_rights_requests"."retention_decision" IN ('retain', 'erase')
          AND "data_rights_requests"."retention_policy_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."retention_required_until" IS NOT NULL
          AND "data_rights_requests"."active_dispute" IN (0, 1))

ck_data_rights_completion.name: ck_data_rights_completion
ck_data_rights_completion.value:
("data_rights_requests"."status" = 'pending' AND "data_rights_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("data_rights_requests"."status" IN ('completed', 'rejected')
          AND "data_rights_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_delivery_options_fingerprints.name: ck_delivery_options_fingerprints
ck_delivery_options_fingerprints.value:
length("delivery_option_snapshots"."shipping_address_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."shipping_address_fingerprint" = lower("delivery_option_snapshots"."shipping_address_fingerprint")
        AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."shipping_address_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND ("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_quote_reference_hash" IS NULL OR (
          length("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_quote_reference_hash") = 64
          AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_quote_reference_hash" = lower("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_quote_reference_hash")
          AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_quote_reference_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        ))
        AND ("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" IS NULL OR (
          length("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_receipt_fingerprint") = 64
          AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" = lower("delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_receipt_fingerprint")
          AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        ))

ck_delivery_options_timestamps.name: ck_delivery_options_timestamps
ck_delivery_options_timestamps.value:
strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',"delivery_option_snapshots"."quoted_at") IS "delivery_option_snapshots"."quoted_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',"delivery_option_snapshots"."expires_at") IS "delivery_option_snapshots"."expires_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',"delivery_option_snapshots"."created_at") IS "delivery_option_snapshots"."created_at"
        AND ("delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at" IS NULL
          OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',"delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at") IS "delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at")
        AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."expires_at" > "delivery_option_snapshots"."quoted_at"
        AND julianday("delivery_option_snapshots"."expires_at") - julianday("delivery_option_snapshots"."quoted_at") <= (1.0 / 24.0)
        AND ("delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at" IS NULL OR (
          "delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at" >= "delivery_option_snapshots"."quoted_at"
          AND "delivery_option_snapshots"."selected_at" < "delivery_option_snapshots"."expires_at"
        ))

ck_delivery_reference_ciphertext.name: ck_delivery_reference_ciphertext
ck_delivery_reference_ciphertext.value:
length("delivery_provider_reference_vault"."ciphertext_base64") BETWEEN 24 AND 704
        AND length("delivery_provider_reference_vault"."ciphertext_base64") % 4 = 0
        AND rtrim("delivery_provider_reference_vault"."ciphertext_base64",'=') NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9+/]*'
        AND length("delivery_provider_reference_vault"."ciphertext_base64")
          - length(rtrim("delivery_provider_reference_vault"."ciphertext_base64",'=')) <= 2

ck_email_outbox_intent.name: ck_email_outbox_intent
ck_email_outbox_intent.value:
("email_outbox"."kind" = 'payment_confirmation' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'payment_succeeded')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'payment_failed' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'payment_failed')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'shipment_confirmation' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'shipment_created')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'refund_confirmation' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'refund_succeeded')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'return_acknowledgement' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'return_received')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'withdrawal_acknowledgement' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'withdrawal_received')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'account_access' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'account_access_challenge')
        OR ("email_outbox"."kind" = 'order_confirmation' AND "email_outbox"."transaction_intent" = 'payment_succeeded')

ck_email_outbox_content_purge.name: ck_email_outbox_content_purge
ck_email_outbox_content_purge.value:
("email_outbox"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."recipient_email" IS NOT NULL AND "email_outbox"."payload_json" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("email_outbox"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "email_outbox"."recipient_email" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."payload_json" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."status" IN ('sent', 'failed', 'cancelled'))

ck_email_outbox_account_access_historica.name: ck_email_outbox_account_access_historical
ck_email_outbox_account_access_historica.value:
"email_outbox"."kind" <> 'account_access' OR (
        "email_outbox"."status" IN ('sent', 'failed', 'cancelled')
        AND "email_outbox"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "email_outbox"."recipient_email" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."payload_json" IS NULL
        AND "email_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL
        AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."leased_at" IS NULL
        AND "email_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

ck_email_outbox_state_shape.name: ck_email_outbox_state_shape
ck_email_outbox_state_shape.value:
("email_outbox"."status" = 'pending' AND "email_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."leased_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."sent_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."terminal_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("email_outbox"."status" = 'sending' AND "email_outbox"."attempts" >= 1
          AND "email_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."leased_at" IS NOT NULL AND "email_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."terminal_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("email_outbox"."status" = 'sent' AND "email_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."leased_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("email_outbox"."status" IN ('failed', 'cancelled') AND "email_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."leased_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."sent_at" IS NULL
          AND "email_outbox"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_email_outbox_lease_hash.name: ck_email_outbox_lease_hash
ck_email_outbox_lease_hash.value:
"email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" IS NULL OR (
        length("email_outbox"."lease_token_hash") = 64
        AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" = lower("email_outbox"."lease_token_hash")
        AND "email_outbox"."lease_token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      )

ck_guest_order_sessions_token_hash.name: ck_guest_order_sessions_token_hash
ck_guest_order_sessions_token_hash.value:
length("guest_order_sessions"."token_hash") = 64
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."token_hash" = lower("guest_order_sessions"."token_hash")
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("guest_order_sessions"."csrf_token_hash") = 64
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."csrf_token_hash" = lower("guest_order_sessions"."csrf_token_hash")
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."csrf_token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

ck_guest_order_sessions_timestamps.name: ck_guest_order_sessions_timestamps
ck_guest_order_sessions_timestamps.value:
strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "guest_order_sessions"."created_at") = "guest_order_sessions"."created_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "guest_order_sessions"."expires_at") = "guest_order_sessions"."expires_at"
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "guest_order_sessions"."idle_expires_at") = "guest_order_sessions"."idle_expires_at"
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."expires_at" > "guest_order_sessions"."created_at"
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."idle_expires_at" > "guest_order_sessions"."created_at"
        AND "guest_order_sessions"."idle_expires_at" <= "guest_order_sessions"."expires_at"
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "guest_order_sessions"."expires_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "guest_order_sessions"."created_at") AS integer) <= 86400
        AND CAST(strftime('%s', "guest_order_sessions"."idle_expires_at") AS integer)
          - CAST(strftime('%s', "guest_order_sessions"."created_at") AS integer) <= 900
        AND ("guest_order_sessions"."last_seen_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "guest_order_sessions"."last_seen_at") = "guest_order_sessions"."last_seen_at")
        AND ("guest_order_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "guest_order_sessions"."revoked_at") = "guest_order_sessions"."revoked_at")

ck_refunds_receipt_fingerprint.name: ck_refunds_receipt_fingerprint
ck_refunds_receipt_fingerprint.value:
"refunds"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" IS NULL
        OR (length("refunds"."provider_receipt_fingerprint") = 64
          AND "refunds"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" = lower("refunds"."provider_receipt_fingerprint")
          AND "refunds"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

ck_return_lines_quantities.name: ck_return_lines_quantities
ck_return_lines_quantities.value:
"return_lines"."requested_quantity" > 0
        AND "return_lines"."received_quantity" >= 0
        AND "return_lines"."received_quantity" <= "return_lines"."requested_quantity"
        AND "return_lines"."sellable_quantity" >= 0
        AND "return_lines"."non_sellable_quantity" >= 0
        AND "return_lines"."sellable_quantity" + "return_lines"."non_sellable_quantity" = "return_lines"."received_quantity"
        AND "return_lines"."restocked_quantity" >= 0
        AND "return_lines"."restocked_quantity" <= "return_lines"."sellable_quantity"

ck_return_requests_source.name: ck_return_requests_source
ck_return_requests_source.value:
("return_requests"."source" = 'customer' AND "return_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "return_requests"."guest_order_session_id" IS NULL AND "return_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("return_requests"."source" = 'guest' AND "return_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL
          AND "return_requests"."guest_order_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "return_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("return_requests"."source" = 'admin' AND "return_requests"."actor_customer_id" IS NULL
          AND "return_requests"."guest_order_session_id" IS NULL AND "return_requests"."actor_admin_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_tracking_events_receipt_shape.name: ck_tracking_events_receipt_shape
ck_tracking_events_receipt_shape.value:
("shipment_tracking_events"."event_type" = 'handed_over' AND "shipment_tracking_events"."carrier_receipt_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("shipment_tracking_events"."event_type" <> 'handed_over' AND "shipment_tracking_events"."carrier_receipt_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_shipments_receipt_fingerprint.name: ck_shipments_receipt_fingerprint

"shipments"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" IS NULL

          AND "shipments"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" = lower("shipments"."provider_receipt_fingerprint")
          AND "shipments"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

ck_shipping_document_hashes.value:
length("shipping_document_metadata"."provider_document_reference_hash") = 64
        AND "shipping_document_metadata"."provider_document_reference_hash" = lower("shipping_document_metadata"."provider_document_reference_hash")
        AND "shipping_document_metadata"."provider_document_reference_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("shipping_document_metadata"."content_sha256") = 64
        AND "shipping_document_metadata"."content_sha256" = lower("shipping_document_metadata"."content_sha256")
        AND "shipping_document_metadata"."content_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

ck_shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots_exact.value:
"shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."source_version" = 'client-validated-2026-08-13'
        AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."length_mm" = 400
        AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."width_mm" = 320
        AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."height_mm" = 40
        AND (

          OR ("shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."item_count" = 2
            AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."profile_code" = 'AJL_ENVELOPE_2_ITEMS_V1'
            AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."weight_grams" = 250)
          OR ("shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."item_count" = 3
            AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."profile_code" = 'AJL_ENVELOPE_3_ITEMS_V1'
            AND "shipping_quote_parcel_snapshots"."weight_grams" = 350)
        )

ck_shipping_quotes_fingerprints.name: ck_shipping_quotes_fingerprints
ck_shipping_quotes_fingerprints.value:
length("shipping_quotes"."cart_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "shipping_quotes"."cart_fingerprint" = lower("shipping_quotes"."cart_fingerprint")
        AND "shipping_quotes"."cart_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("shipping_quotes"."shipping_address_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "shipping_quotes"."shipping_address_fingerprint" = lower("shipping_quotes"."shipping_address_fingerprint")
        AND "shipping_quotes"."shipping_address_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND ("shipping_quotes"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" IS NULL
          OR (length("shipping_quotes"."provider_receipt_fingerprint") = 64
            AND "shipping_quotes"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" = lower("shipping_quotes"."provider_receipt_fingerprint")
            AND "shipping_quotes"."provider_receipt_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))

          AND "shipping_zone_configurations"."estimated_days_max" >= "shipping_zone_configurations"."estimated_days_min")
